from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """A representation of a single paper from the collection and its internal citation links."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper as provided in the document")
    cites_titles_from_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers from the provided collection that this paper explicitly references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Output for a single document, capturing its identity and citations."""
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
